items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Mel Washburn, you ever hear of him? No I haven't.

ctx.x: Oops and it's also turned off.

Well I just want to tell you this. When I went into the commercial field, I was commercial down. I put on a show here for the Lions Club. From voodooism to the present. I rehearsed the piano, piano and drums and all that. I would bring fifteen men there to take rehearsal money when they're not even going to blow the horn. Then I'd put it all together. That's why I'd get in the building. I'd have someone in the building. I was strictly running. I played the preview for this Admiral's Sons. You know I say those…
